title: Why Having Twins Got So Much More Common
hook: Your town saw twin births double to 34 per 1,000!
closing: Two really did become the new one.
question: Do twins run in your family?

segments.say: Twin births in the US climbed to almost 34 per thousand by 2014, way up from decades earlier.
Mothers over 40 twin nearly five times more often than the youngest moms.
Twin births from IVF have collapsed to just 2 percent of twin births today.
